full_judgment: 3. On the other hand, the defendants-opposite parties contested the suit by filing written statement denying the material allegations made in the plaint and stating, inter alia, that Shahar Mai Bibi was the tenant under the original landlord Najargpat Singh and others. Subsequently, Shahar Mai Bibi sold the suit land to Amiruddin Paramanik, the predecessor of the defendants in CS record. That out of 3.28 decimals of land 2.02 decimal was in khas possession of Amiruddin and he made pattani settlement of the remaining land and it was recorded in CS Khatian Nos. 87, 88, 91, 92 and 93 respectively. That Shibran Mohanto, predecessor of the plaintiff, was a borgadar under Amiruddin Paramanik and thereafter SA khatian was wrongly prepared in the name of Amiruddin Paramanik and Shibran Mohanto which Amiruddin did not know in his life time. Since Shibran Mohanto did not give the borga crops regularly, so Amiruddin Paramanik returned back the land in his own possession. Thereafter, when settlement operation for preparing SA record was started the fake right of Shibran Mohanto was cancelled.
